Great app.. After trying out a dozen of these AI enhancement apps this is by far the best deal. It works just as well as the other apps, if not better. And it’s one time payment is about half of what the other apps want you to pay weekly. My one and only complaint is it can’t colorize redheads. I tried it using a picture of Lucille Ball and she ended up with pink hair and blue/brown eyes. But none of the apps can do that. Most make her a blonde with brown or green eyes. Still a great deal anyway. Good job.

Not impressed. I tried this app a while ago and I’m still not impressed. I thought they would have made it better by now, but all they did was add more features without improving the crucial issue of poor image enhancement quality. I haven’t even been able to use the new image recoloring feature because the server is always busy. Overall, I expected more from their efforts to enhance its functionality.

Edit: I was able to use the recolonization feature and I’m extremely unimpressed. When the server aren’t busy all it does is make a t-shirt red or something. Horrible, never reinstalling.

The power of AI. This app really does seem to use AI to upscale your images. It took an image it was 584 x 900 and turned it into 2336 x 3600. Handy if you create low resolution AI art on your phone and you want to upscale it to a decent size without having to take it to a separate website or device.

Not Getting Desired Results. Every test has made photos softer, I thought this was supposed to make them sharper. I tried on a single selfie, a selfie with 2 people and a picture of food. All results had a smooth, even softness to them. Maybe it hides some skin in perfections but it comes at the cost of everything else being soft too. All textures, all details. It all looks like it took a small image and blew it up bigger and found a way to soften the added fake additional pixels and artifacts that come with blowing up a photo larger than the original.

Very fun and professional. I onkybused the free version but it was so neat and good at in away restoring old pics or dark ones! Will definitely keep and even pay for. Thanks y'all!!!! Happy Pic takin!

Very happy. This app is so easy to use. Family member sent pictures to me that did not have the best clarity. I used this app to make the pictures better. I highly recommend this app. If it even makes pictures of your loved ones slightly better, it’s all worth it.

Not Good. I tried two of my photos. One photo needed a bit more clarity, in my opinion, and the other was very sharp and clear showing nearly every hair on a dog’s back. When I completed the first photo of a group of people the app reduce the clarity and modify the features of people so much that a couple of them rather monstrous and unrecognisable and clarity was reduced while contrast was inceased far too much. In the second photo of a dog it reduced the clarity so much that the body of dog was smooth with no hint of hair. In my admittedly limited experience I found that this app makes good photos bad. Thankfully, it saved the modifications as new photos so the originals were left in their original states.

Over sharpens pictures with hair.. Would love to give a better review as this app does a somewhat good job sharpening the center of pictures. 

My test photo was a bushy tailed squirrel where the individual hairs on the original picture was razor sharp. When I looked at the preview pane, the hair was blurred really bad. 

The center of the pictures looked sharper but still kinda blurred the fur of the squirrel in the overall scheme of things.

The one thing that really lets this app down is that it saves my 20mp image as a 3mp shot. I would have hoped it would keep the original resolution of the original image. That’s disappointing.

Impressive. If you’ve any old photos, negatives or slides that you photographed, this app will do an amazing job of cleaning them up (or colourising black and white photos).

 If any faces are very blurry the AI will likely give you a bit of “uncanny valley” as it has to do a bit of guesswork. 

Regardless, this app is very impressive.
